termux-shell.title: Termux Shell Tool
termux-shell.description: Add termux_shell tool to ClosePaw via Termux bridge daemon. Full Linux bash shell capability through HTTP bridge on localhost, enabling workspace operations (file R/W, git, python, build tools) alongside existing UI automation. 6 phases: substrate, bridge daemon, bridge manager, shell tool, agent wiring, settings+QA.
acceptCriteria: termux_shell tool functional in BASIC and PRO modes

ts-phase1-substrate.title: Phase 1: Substrate (Manifest + Network + Resource)
ts-phase1-substrate.description: AndroidManifest.xml package visibility, network_security_config.xml localhost cleartext exception, bridge.py raw resource packaging, and verification tests.

ts-manifest-visibility.title: AndroidManifest.xml: Termux package visibility + RUN_COMMAND
ts-manifest-visibility.description: Add Termux package visibility declaration and RUN_COMMAND service intent query to AndroidManifest.xml. Required for bootstrap flow to discover and communicate with Termux via RUN_COMMAND intent. Add com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND permission, <package android:name="com.termux" /> in queries, and <intent><action android:name="com.termux.RUN_COMMAND" /></intent> in queries.

ts-network-security.title: network_security_config.xml: localhost cleartext exception
ts-network-security.description: Add 127.0.0.1 cleartext traffic exception to network_security_config.xml. Bridge daemon runs on localhost:18422 over HTTP. Narrow exception: only 127.0.0.1, includeSubdomains=false. base-config remains cleartextTrafficPermitted=false.

ts-bridge-resource.title: Bridge script packaging: res/raw + Gradle copy + version constant
ts-bridge-resource.description: Create tools/termux-bridge/closepaw_bridge.py as canonical source with BRIDGE_VERSION = "1" at top. Add Gradle copy task to package it as app/src/main/res/raw/closepaw_bridge_py. The copy task ensures the raw resource is always byte-identical to the canonical source. Version constant appears in /v1/health response and is checked by TermuxBridgeManager for re-deploy decisions.
acceptCriteria: Gradle copy task copies tools/termux-bridge/closepaw_bridge.py to res/raw/closepaw_bridge_py

ts-substrate-tests.title: Substrate verification tests
ts-substrate-tests.description: CI test: raw resource exists and contains expected BRIDGE_VERSION line. Instrumentation test: OkHttp can reach http://127.0.0.1 under release network security config (validates cleartext exception works). These tests gate Phase 2.
acceptCriteria: JVM test asserts raw resource contains BRIDGE_VERSION line
Instrumentation test asserts OkHttp can connect to http://127.0.0.1 under release config

ts-review-phase1.title: Codex review: Phase 1 Substrate
ts-review-phase1.description: Codex code-review of all Phase 1 changes: manifest, network_security_config, bridge resource packaging, and substrate tests.

ts-phase2-bridge-daemon.title: Phase 2: Bridge Daemon (Host-Side Python)
ts-phase2-bridge-daemon.description: Implement the Python bridge daemon (~150 lines, stdlib only) that runs inside Termux. ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:18422 with /v1/exec and /v1/health endpoints. Handles process lifecycle, output capping, exec serialization, and idle shutdown.

ts-bridge-server.title: Bridge HTTP server + endpoints + pidfile management
ts-bridge-server.description: Implement ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1:18422 with /v1/exec (POST) and /v1/health (GET) endpoints. Pidfile management: write {pid, port, version, identity: "closepaw-bridge"} on start. On startup: if pidfile exists, check identity → kill old bridge if ours, return port_in_use if not. Idempotent startup. All responses JSON. Health returns {status, version, identity}.

ts-bridge-exec.title: Bridge exec: timeout, disconnect, output cap, exec lock
ts-bridge-exec.description: Implement /v1/exec execution loop: subprocess.Popen(["bash", "-c", command]) with start_new_session=True for process-group kill. Two drain threads for stdout/stderr to avoid pipe deadlock. Process-group kill on timeout (os.killpg). Client disconnect detection (poll socket) triggers immediate kill. Output cap with independent stdout/stderr truncation: each has _truncated boolean and _ref path to artifact file in ~/.closepaw/artifacts/. Exec lock: only one /v1/exec at a time, busy returns HTTP 409. Non-zero exit code returns HTTP 200 with exit_code field.

ts-bridge-watchdog.title: Bridge idle watchdog (30 min auto-exit)
ts-bridge-watchdog.description: Implement 30-minute idle watchdog. Track last request timestamp. Background thread checks periodically; if no /v1/exec or /v1/health received within 30 minutes, server shuts down gracefully. Saves battery on Android device.
acceptCriteria: Bridge auto-exits after 30 min of no requests

ts-bridge-pytest.title: Host-side pytest for bridge daemon
ts-bridge-pytest.description: Comprehensive host-side pytest suite covering: health endpoint, exec endpoint, timeout (process-group kill), exit code passthrough, output cap (stdout and stderr independently), artifact overflow (stdout_ref/stderr_ref), stale daemon pidfile handling, port conflict detection (port_in_use error), busy lock (409 on concurrent exec). Tests run against a real bridge process started in-process or subprocess.
acceptCriteria: Tests cover: health, exec, timeout, exit code, output cap, stdout overflow, stderr overflow, stale daemon, port conflict, busy 409

ts-review-phase2.title: Codex review: Phase 2 Bridge Daemon
ts-review-phase2.description: Codex code-review of bridge daemon: closepaw_bridge.py, exec loop, health endpoint, pidfile, output cap, idle watchdog, and host-side pytest.

ts-phase3-bridge-manager.title: Phase 3: TermuxBridgeManager + Bootstrap
ts-phase3-bridge-manager.description: Kotlin-side bridge lifecycle management: TermuxBridgeManager (process-wide singleton via Holder pattern), TermuxRunCommandAdapter for bootstrap, 4-step bootstrap flow, health polling, and settings integration.

ts-bridge-manager-core.title: TermuxBridgeManager core: Holder + StateFlow + status types
ts-bridge-manager-core.description: Implement TermuxBridgeManagerHolder (process-wide singleton, double-check locking like AuthStoreHolder). TermuxBridgeManager with StateFlow<TermuxBridgeStatus>, Mutex-serialized setup/health/restart methods, and snapshot() returning immutable TermuxCapabilitySnapshot. Status sealed class: NotInstalled, NeedsSetup(reason), SetupInProgress, Ready, Disabled. TermuxCapabilitySnapshot data class: available (bridge ready AND user enabled), enabled (settings toggle), status (debug/logging).

ts-run-command-adapter.title: TermuxRunCommandAdapter: RUN_COMMAND intent + PendingIntent result
ts-run-command-adapter.description: Implement TermuxRunCommandAdapter that sends RUN_COMMAND intents to Termux and receives results via PendingIntent BroadcastReceiver. Each call generates unique requestId to ignore stale/late results. Supports EXTRA_STDIN for bridge.py deployment via base64 encoding (avoids shell quoting). Returns RunCommandResult(stdout, stderr, exitCode). Handles SecurityException (permission missing) and ActivityNotFoundException (Termux not installed / allow-external-apps disabled).

ts-bootstrap-flow.title: Termux detection + 4-step bootstrap flow
ts-bootstrap-flow.description: Implement Termux detection via PackageManager (check com.termux installed). 4-step idempotent bootstrap with probe-derived readiness: Step 1 (Probe) - RUN_COMMAND echo CLOSEPAW_PROBE=ok, verify Termux initialized + allow-external-apps + permission. Step 2 (Install) - pkg install -y python git ripgrep, verify with which. Step 3 (Deploy) - deploy bridge.py via EXTRA_STDIN base64, create workspace/artifacts/logs dirs, verify CLOSEPAW_DEPLOY=ok marker. Step 4 (Start) - python3 ~/.closepaw/bridge.py &, poll /v1/health until ready with correct version. Each step has explicit success marker. Failure maps to NeedsSetup(reason).
acceptCriteria: Bootstrap flow handles all 4 steps with idempotent re-entry

ts-health-lifecycle.title: Health polling, restart, version mismatch, settings toggle
ts-health-lifecycle.description: Implement health polling at 30s interval via /v1/health. On bridge failure: restart via RUN_COMMAND. On version mismatch: re-deploy bridge.py from raw resource then restart. Enabled toggle persisted in AppSettingsStore. Health polling updates TermuxBridgeManager.state (affects next session, not current). Bridge 30-min idle watchdog handled server-side; client just restarts on next session if bridge exited.

ts-review-phase3.title: Codex review: Phase 3 Bridge Manager + Bootstrap
ts-review-phase3.description: Codex code-review of TermuxBridgeManager, TermuxRunCommandAdapter, bootstrap flow, health lifecycle, and settings toggle.

ts-phase4-shell-tool.title: Phase 4: TermuxShellTool
ts-phase4-shell-tool.description: Implement TermuxShellTool as a ToolSpec, OkHttp HTTP client to bridge daemon, result mapping, ToolName registration, and turn ordering policy update.

ts-shell-tool-impl.title: TermuxShellTool: ToolSpec + OkHttp + cancellation
ts-shell-tool-impl.description: Implement TermuxShellTool extending ToolSpec. Tool parameters: command (required), cwd (optional, defaults to workspace root), timeout_seconds (optional, default 120s, max 120s). OkHttp client with explicit read/call timeout = timeout_ms + 5000ms grace period (not OkHttp default 10s). Cancellable via suspendCancellableCoroutine with cont.invokeOnCancellation { call.cancel() }. Coroutine cancel -> Call.cancel() -> TCP disconnect -> bridge kills subprocess.

ts-shell-tool-result.title: TermuxShellTool result mapping
ts-shell-tool-result.description: Implement result mapping from bridge HTTP responses to ToolExecutionResult. HTTP 200 with any exit_code -> Success (stdout/stderr/exit_code as tool output). HTTP 200 with timed_out=true -> Success (partial output + timeout info). HTTP 409 busy -> Failure (bridge busy, LLM can retry). HTTP 4xx/5xx -> Failure (transport/protocol error). Connection refused/timeout -> Failure (bridge not available). IOException -> Failure (network error). Non-zero exit code is NOT a Failure - it is informational for the LLM.
acceptCriteria: Non-zero exit code maps to Success, not Failure

ts-tool-registration.title: ToolName + TurnToolPolicy for termux_shell
ts-tool-registration.description: Add TermuxShell to ToolName enum with isScreenChanging=false (auto-allow policy, same as existing shell tool). Update TurnToolPolicy: termux_shell must NOT be hoistable. Only cognitive tools (scratchpad, write_todos, remember_experience) are hoistable. termux_shell, shell, ask_user, activate_skill preserve LLM-returned order.

ts-shell-tool-tests.title: TermuxShellTool unit tests
ts-shell-tool-tests.description: Unit tests for TermuxShellTool covering: JSON schema validation, result mapping (200 success, 200 timed_out, 409 busy, connection error), cancellation (Call.cancel() invoked on coroutine cancel), non-zero exit code handling (maps to Success not Failure), timeout parameter validation, OkHttp timeout configuration (timeout_ms + 5s grace).
acceptCriteria: Tests cover: schema, result mapping (200/409/error), cancellation, non-zero exit code, timeout config

ts-review-phase4.title: Codex review: Phase 4 TermuxShellTool
ts-review-phase4.description: Codex code-review of TermuxShellTool implementation: ToolSpec, OkHttp client, result mapping, cancellation, ToolName, TurnToolPolicy changes.

ts-phase5-agent-wiring.title: Phase 5: Agent Wiring
ts-phase5-agent-wiring.description: Wire TermuxShellTool into the agent system: shell description update, system prompt extension, conditional tool registration via TermuxCapabilitySnapshot, AgentRoleDef.resolve(), runner integration, PRO mode delegation contract, and checkpoint reload.

ts-prompt-updates.title: Shell description + system prompt extension
ts-prompt-updates.description: Update existing shell tool description to clarify toybox scope and guide users to termux_shell for full toolchain. New description: "Android toybox shell. Limited commands (ls, cat, stat, grep, etc.), no pipe/redirect. Use termux_shell for full toolchain (python/git etc)." Add system prompt Workspace Shell section (injected when TermuxCapabilitySnapshot.available is true): termux_shell description, when-to-use-which-shell guidance, UI vs shell guidance, workspace path ~/closepaw/workspace/.

ts-conditional-registration.title: Conditional tool registration + AgentRoleDef.resolve()
ts-conditional-registration.description: Implement conditional tool registration: read TermuxCapabilitySnapshot (immutable, captured at session start) to decide whether to register TermuxShellTool. Add AgentRoleDef.resolve(snapshot, excludedTools) -> ResolvedAgentRole. ResolvedAgentRole contains adjusted allowedTools (base + termux_shell if available - excluded), systemPrompt (+ workspace section if tool exposed), and timeoutMs (150s for executor when termux available). Prompt injection follows tool exposure: if termux_shell excluded, workspace prompt section also excluded.

ts-runner-wiring.title: Runner wiring: SessionAgentRunner + IsolatedSubAgentRunner + role allow-lists
ts-runner-wiring.description: Wire ResolvedAgentRole into SessionAgentRunner and IsolatedSubAgentRunner. Both read the resolved role (not raw AgentRoleDef). All 3 roles (Standalone, Planner, Executor) get termux_shell when available. Executor timeout increases to 150s when termux_shell is exposed (long-running commands need headroom above 120s bridge timeout + 5s grace). Snapshot capture path: SessionServices.create() -> SessionServices field -> SessionAgentRunner.start() -> AgentRoleDef.resolve() -> ResolvedAgentRole.

ts-pro-mode.title: PRO mode delegation + checkpoint reload
ts-pro-mode.description: PRO mode: Planner runs workspace commands (termux_shell) directly, does not delegate to Executor. Planner prompt addition: "For workspace commands (termux_shell), execute directly instead of delegating." delegate_task description unchanged: "delegate ONE atomic UI action." Checkpoint reload: session restore at task boundary captures fresh TermuxCapabilitySnapshot (not serialized from old snapshot). SessionServices.create() is the single capture point. Integration tests: tool present/absent matches prompt present/absent.
acceptCriteria: Planner prompt includes guidance to run termux_shell directly
delegate_task description still says UI action only
SessionServices.create() captures fresh TermuxCapabilitySnapshot on reload
Integration test: tool present iff prompt section present

ts-review-phase5.title: Codex review: Phase 5 Agent Wiring
ts-review-phase5.description: Codex code-review of agent wiring: shell description, prompt extension, conditional registration, ResolvedAgentRole, runner wiring, PRO mode, checkpoint reload.

ts-phase6-settings-qa.title: Phase 6: Settings UI + QA
ts-phase6-settings-qa.description: Settings UI for Termux Shell toggle in Agent Behavior page, and comprehensive QA: workspace tasks, UI regression, mixed tasks, turn ordering, cancellation, bootstrap recovery.

ts-settings-ui.title: Agent Behavior settings: Termux Shell row
ts-settings-ui.description: Add Termux Shell row to Agent Behavior settings page. Three-state display: Ready, Needs Setup (tap to setup), Not Installed (tap to install). Toggle switch for enable/disable. Typed reason for debug (permission missing, allow-external-apps missing, packages missing, bridge outdated, health timeout, port_in_use). "Setup changes apply next session" messaging. Reads TermuxBridgeManager.state for current status.
acceptCriteria: Settings UI shows Termux Shell row with 3-state indicator
"applies next session" message shown on state change

ts-qa-workspace.title: QA: workspace tasks + UI regression + mixed tasks
ts-qa-workspace.description: End-to-end QA: (1) Pure workspace task in BASIC mode - run a command via termux_shell, verify output. (2) Pure workspace task in PRO mode - Planner uses termux_shell directly. (3) Pure UI task - verify no regression in mobile_action/system_button/etc. (4) Mixed UI+workspace task - combine UI navigation with termux_shell file operations in single session.
acceptCriteria: Pure workspace task passes in BASIC mode
Pure workspace task passes in PRO mode (Planner runs shell directly)
Pure UI task passes with no regression
resources: Android device with Termux installed and configured
ts-qa-workspace.note: Verified on emulator-5554 (AndroidWorldAvd, Android 13, Termux 0.118.1): /v1/exec happy path returns expected payload; env propagation works; non-zero exit_code passes through as Success; timeout returns timed_out=true with exit_code=null; workspace_escape rejected; bootstrap completes after fixing 3 bugs (see commit cdfe52a0).

ts-qa-ordering-cancel.title: QA: turn ordering + cancellation
ts-qa-ordering-cancel.description: Test turn ordering: mobile_action + termux_shell in same turn must NOT be reordered (both non-hoistable). Only cognitive tools (scratchpad, write_todos) hoist ahead. Test cancellation: stop session during long-running termux_shell command -> verify bridge subprocess killed promptly (not waiting 120s timeout). Verify OkHttp Call.cancel() -> TCP disconnect -> bridge process-group kill.
acceptCriteria: Turn ordering test: mobile_action + termux_shell preserve LLM order
Cancellation test: session stop during long command kills subprocess within seconds
resources: Android device with Termux installed and configured
ts-qa-ordering-cancel.note: Verified on emulator-5554: client-disconnect kills process group (sleep PID gone within 1s of curl --max-time disconnect); exec_lock releases immediately so next /v1/exec succeeds. Turn-ordering is unit-tested (TurnToolPolicyTest).

ts-qa-bootstrap.title: QA: bootstrap step failures + recovery
ts-qa-bootstrap.description: Test each bootstrap step failure and recovery: Step 1 (Probe) - Termux not installed, permission missing, allow-external-apps disabled. Step 2 (Install) - pkg install failure, partial install recovery. Step 3 (Deploy) - bridge.py write failure, re-deploy on version mismatch. Step 4 (Start) - bridge start failure, health check timeout. Also test: checkpoint/reload does not resurrect dead bridge (fresh snapshot at SessionServices.create()). Each failure shows typed reason in Settings UI.
acceptCriteria: Each bootstrap step failure produces correct typed reason
Recovery from each failure mode succeeds on retry
Checkpoint reload captures fresh snapshot (dead bridge not resurrected)
Settings UI shows appropriate status for each failure
resources: Android device with Termux (may need to simulate failures via package removal, permission revocation)
ts-qa-bootstrap.note: Verified on emulator-5554: cold-start probe captures live state (cold-start fix wired); 4-step bootstrap reaches Ready (probe/install/deploy/start). Bootstrap surfaced 3 production bugs that are now fixed: probe err=-1 misclassification, missing which binary, NotInstalled tap stuck on F-Droid. Bootstrap recovery on transient failure (e.g., emulator clock skew → apt date check) confirmed via retry.

ts-review-phase6.title: Codex review: Phase 6 Settings UI + QA
ts-review-phase6.description: Codex code-review of settings UI, QA test results, and overall integration. Final sign-off before merge.
